messages.content: You write a short, warm daily "sky report" for a Discord community, explaining astronomy/astrology facts computed by a deterministic ephemeris service and, separately, today's lectionary reading. You are given exact numbers and a lection outcome as JSON in the next message — never invent, guess, or adjust any of them. Cover, in this order: (1) what today's Sun and Moon sign placements mean, (2) what the Moon phase and illumination mean, (3) the day's lection — if lection.outcome is "found", present its reading plainly; if it is "no-entry-recorded", say in one plain sentence that this system's own recorded tables don't reach today's date yet — never say or imply that the lectionary itself has no reading for today, since the RCL assigns one to every day. Do not name, describe, paraphrase, or guess at any source website or URL for the lection, and do not invent a reading — the exact source note and link are appended after your text by the system itself, verbatim, so leave that detail out entirely. Keep it to 3-5 short paragraphs, plain prose suitable for a Discord message, no markdown headers.

completion.text:
Hey everyone, here's your daily sky report for July 19th, 2026.

The Sun is currently in the sign of Cancer, which is associated with emotions, family, and nurturing. With the Sun in Cancer, we may feel more protective and caring towards those we love, and we may be more inclined to focus on our personal relationships and domestic life. The Sun is at 26 degrees in Cancer, which is a relatively stable position, suggesting that we may be feeling more grounded and secure.

The Moon is in the sign of Virgo, which is associated with analysis, practicality, and hard work. With the Moon in Virgo, we may be more detail-oriented and critical, and we may be more inclined to focus on our daily routines and tasks. The Moon is at 27 degrees in Virgo, which is a position that suggests we may be feeling more analytical and discerning.

The Moon is currently in the waxing crescent phase, which means it's growing and increasing in brightness. This phase is associated with new beginnings, growth, and expansion. The Moon is about 26% illuminated, which suggests that we may be starting to see the light at the end of the tunnel and feeling more optimistic about the future.

Today's lection is from the Revised Common Lectionary, and it's for Proper 11 (16) on Sunday, July 19th, 2026. The reading is from the book of Genesis, specifically Genesis 28:10-19a, which tells the story of Jacob's journey to Haran and his encounter with the angel at Bethel. The psalm reading is from Psalm 139:1-12, 23-24, which is a beautiful and comforting psalm that speaks of God's presence and love. The wisdom reading is from the book of Wisdom, specifically Wisdom 12:13, 16-19, which speaks of God's justice and mercy. The gospel reading is from Matthew 13:24-30, 36-43, which tells the story of the weeds among the wheat and the importance of perseverance and faith.

I hope you find this information helpful and interesting!
